upstream_behavior: xmlNodeListGetString over a node list that produces no text returns a NUL-terminated empty string; the empty result must be a real, readable string.
candidate_defect: Five sites used the Rust idiom `b"" as *const u8 as *const xmlChar` to build an empty xmlChar string. A zero-length byte-string literal casts to a DANGLING pointer (Rust emits address 0x1 for the empty slice), and xml_strdup/xml_strlen dereference it -> SIGSEGV. The path is reached when a non-text node list (element chain) yields no text content.
php_trigger: SimpleXML string cast of an element whose children produce no direct text: trim($xml) in ext/simplexml 027/028 -> sxe_object_cast_ex -> xmlNodeListGetString -> crash in xml_strlen(0x1).
generic_fix: Replace `b"" as *const u8 as *const xmlChar` with `c"".as_ptr() as *const xmlChar` (a real NUL-terminated static) at all five sites (exports_treedump.rs node_list_get_string_internal x3 + attr text default; exports_string.rs attr text default).
